title: Unique Bitter Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A light and romantic Jamaican dish featuring tinned tomatoes and a mortar-pestle-pound technique, perfect for a bitter and high-protein friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the curry powder, thyme, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped scotch bonnet pepper and cook for an additional minute.
Add the crushed tinned tomatoes and stir to combine.
Add the chicken breast and stir to coat with the curry mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Use a mortar and pestle to pound the curry mixture and create a smooth sauce.
Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or with roti.
